heading: Selected Works
subheading: Curated projects from the last 12 months.

items.title: Geolink Podcast
items.description: Turning audio into a visual experience. A bold, editorial brand identity designed to amplify student voices and connect academia with industry.
items.challenge: Podcasts are audio-first. The challenge was creating a visual language that could capture attention on social media and communicate the depth of the conversations.
items.solution: We stepped away from rigid academic aesthetics and created a bold design. Using high-contrast portraits of hosts and guests, the design feels editorial, conversational, and modern

items.title: Viral Creative Suite
items.description: High-impact thumbnail design engineered for maximum Click-Through Rate (CTR). Visual storytelling condensed into a single frame.
items.challenge: In the digital economy, you have 0.5 seconds to capture attention. The challenge is balancing clickability with brand integrity.
items.solution: We focus on visual hierarchy, facial emotion, and high-contrast color theory. Each thumbnail is treated as a billboard, designed to stop the scroll and drive engagement.

items.title: AusIMM Tarkwa Student Chapter
items.description: Directing the visual communication for the Tarkwa Student Chapter of the AusIMM. Bridging the gap between technical engineering data and accessible public information.
items.challenge: Engineering organizations often struggle to look modern. The challenge was to maintain professional rigor while making the chapter appealing to the next generation of geologists.
items.solution: I developed a clean, corporate visual system. As PRO, I ensured every piece of communication reinforced our authority, moving away from cluttered designs to a "International Standard" aesthetic.
